machinist.d: A specialist in synthetic metallurgy protected by a large shield wall. This Corpus Tech brandishes a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneratrion. Summons a Mine Osprey.

m-w.a.m..d: The Multi-Weapon Assault Moa is equipped with a number of weapons to assist the brokers employed by Zenith Galactical with endeavors.

nako xol.d: The younger brother of Ved Xol displayed no aptitude for business. Instead, his enthusiasm for violence and conflict have helped him quickly climb corporate ranks.

nemes.d: Charges its target and detonates when threatened

nemes rt.d: Follows a target while attacking them with lasers

optio.d: A high-ranking Corpus official who is armed with a power cryo beam and deploys Cryo Sentries.

orm basilisk.d: This fighter attacks with a tracking turret that delivers focused bursts from its energy beam.

orm crewship.d: Heavy Crewship fitted with assault beams, boarding ramsleds and missile swarms. Deploys a drone to shield allied fighter craft. Armor reinforced with security nodes.

orm gox.d: Protected by frontal shields and armed with a high-discharge plasma cannon.

orm harpi.d: Attack fighter armed with rapid-fire plasma cannon.

orm numon.d: Specialist boarding unit, armed with repeat scatter blaster for shredding enemy personnel.

orm pilot.d: Trained to fly Crewships and armed with a laser pistol.

orm vambac.d: Specialist boarding unit trained to wreak havoc on crew and equipment with his proximity-granade launcher.

orm zerca.d: Specialist boarding unit, armed with an impact-hammer capable of rapidly disabling critical ship systems.

oxium osprey.d: Charges its target and detonates when threatened

pelna cade.d: Pelna Cade is a skilled technician who graduated with the Xol brothers. Remaining close friends with the family following their military service together, he now works for them to keep the robotics in their service in peak condition.

profit-taker orb.d: Monster of the Vallis and protector of Enrichment Labs, this massive Orb appears to be invulnerable.

protea specter.d: The victim and beneficiary of Parvos Granum's research into Specter Particle Theory, this is all that remains of the Protea Warframe who sacrificed herself to keep Granum safe in a pocket realm beyond time.

rabbleback hyena.d: This Hyena has been heavily modified to fire its spines as guided projectiles.

rana del.d: More than just a broker, Rana is a hostile customer relations specialist. When investors refuse to pay their debts, they can look forward to a visit from her.

raptor rx.d: The Index marks the debut of the X-series of the Raptor. This version of armoured Osprey doubles as both a mobile accounting system and security detail for the brokers employed by Anyo Corp.

ratel.d: Compact robots that hunt with relentless zeal.

sapping osprey.d: Energy orb pulses AoE damage after detonation

scavenger drone.d: Collects fallen items on the battlefield

scrofa armaments director.d: Director of the Subterranean Armaments Division. Responsible for all research into weapons that can more effectively combat all things fungal.

scrofa attack drone.d: An attack drone that deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets.

scrofa crewman.d: A seasoned combatant specializing in subterranean warfrare.

scrofa decoy moa.d: Facilitates weapon testing for the Jackal.

scrofa drover bursa.d: A Bursa unit that corrals its prey for rapid destruction.

scrofa elite crewman.d: An elite combatant that controls the battlefield through a combination of teleportation and decoy deployment.

scrofa energy chief.d: Chief researcher officer of the Subterranean Energy Division. Responcible for producing new methods of energy production to fuel Nef Anyo's ambitions.

scrofa grenadier crewman.d: A seasoned combatant that utilizes multiple grenade types to deal heavy damage.

scrofa heavy trencher.d: A large hatchet and flying charge attacks make this heavy unit a capable foe.

scrofa joro raknoid.d: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.

scrofa laser moa.d: A quick-moving Moa, armed with a laser disc weapon.

scrofa legionary.d: A quick-moving uniit that closes the distance with it's target through a bettering shield, before striking with it's hammer.

scrofa lythrum raknoid.d: This mid-sized Raknoid spits immobilizing fluid from it's sac before latching onto prey with it's grappling hook.

scrofa mite raknoid.d: A diminutive Raknoid that can close large distances with it's jumping attack.

scrofa plasmor crewman.d: A shotgun wielding combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.

scrofa railgun moa.d: A Moa unit that fires from range while laying mines.

scrofa research chief.d: Chief technology officer of the Subterranean Research Division. Responcible for reaserching Syzygy energy to the benefit of Nef Anyo.

scrofa shield osprey.d: An Osprey that recharges the shields of it's allies.

scrofa shockwave moa.d: A Moa unit capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.

scrofa sniper ranger.d: A unit that deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.

scrofa strike director.d: Director of the Subterranean Strike Division. Responcible for coordinating attacks on targets that drw Nef Anyo's ire.

scyto raknoid.d: This mid-sized Raknoid is highly mobile and attacks by latching onto prey with a grappling hook or spitting deadly fluid from its sac.

senta turret (orb vallis).d: Fires armor-shattering shells at a rapid rate.

sentient research director.d: Director of Sentient studies at Enrichment Labs. The man Nef Anyo has entrusted to reverse engineer recovered Sentient technology.

specter particles.d: Energy released when an Errant Specter is defeated. Used to charge the Xoris glaive.

tarask bursa.d: Elite Corpus robot. Launches tether-mines to ensnare opponents. Kinetic gun blasts have a strong knockback effect. Deploys defensive Aurax Moas to shield itself.

terra elite trencher.d: Dual ice-picks and a flying charge attack make a deadly capable foe.

terra embattor moa.d: Lays bounce mines and launches artillery barrages.

terra jailer.d: Guards Solaris who have been detained for repossession.

terra manker.d: Heavy, energy shotgun wielding combat unit.

tia mayn.d: Tia supports her allies by providing them with effective exit strategies when a deal takes a turn for the worse. These strategies often leave the other party with significant medical fees.

treasurer.d: One of Parvos' favored, keeper of the tokens of his esteem.

vallis surveillance drone.d: Patrols the Vallis and reports any suspicious activity back to command.

vapos aquila.d: Nimble and relentless, the Aquila is the staple dogfighter of the Corpus fleet.

vapos condor dropship.d: Dropship or gunship? Retrofitted for the challenges of Gas City and designed to rapidly deploy force to any security breach.

vapos condor elite dropship.d: Dropship or gunship? Retrofitted for the challenges of Gas City and designed to rapidly deploy force to any security breach.

ved xol.d: Ved Xol was nominated to become the head of the Loan Reclamation Division at Anyo Corp. after demonstrating ruthless aptitude within the Index. He has obtained favorable results with his team on many occasions, and is a firm favourite amongst corporate backers.

vivisect director.d: Enrichment Labs director of animal dissection and experimentation. Works closely with the Feed and Research Division.

carrion charger.d: Spawned the body of a creature killed by infested, these charges are fast with weak claw attacks.

deimos ancient healer.d: Heavy melee that applies damage reduction buff to allies.

deimos brood mother.d: Spawns maggots that attack its target

deimos carnis.d: Carnis are many-legged hunters, ferocious and ever-hungry. They scuttle just out of reach trying to wear down their prey with ranged attacks until they can rush in to consume it.

deimos carnis rex.d: The Carnis Rex is a true terror, a monstrously-large Carnis. The Carneis Rex rushes headlong upon their prey, often coiling into a spinning wheel in its haste to come to grips.

deimos genetrix.d: Genetrix act as mobile wombs for the Infested hordes, discharging swarms of Infested whenever they detect a non-Infested intruder. A Genetrix prominent sensor stalk must be disabled or avoided to stem a seemingly unending tide of monsters.

deimos jugulus.d: A writhing tower of flesh and gristle, the Jugulus lurks beneath the surface and emerges to launch streams of organic projectiles from its wide maw.

deimos leaping thrasher.d: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.

deimos saxum.d: Saxum are bipedal, medium-sized assailants capable of short-ranged attacks and a powerful grand slam in melee.

deimos saxum rex.d: Saxum Rex are larger, meaner Saxum and represent a considerably enhanced threat. How they achieve this evolution is unknown, but cannibalism is suspected.

deimos tendril drone.d: An infested drone as brutal and unforgiving as Deimos itself.

deimos therid.d: The cunning Therid uses its long arms to spin a ball of corrosive gossamer that it hurls with a surprising force. It has also been known to scoop up smaller infested to throw at intruders as an improvised projectile/delivery system.

deimos undying flyer.d: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.

demolisher boiler.d: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

demolisher charger.d: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!

electric crawler.d: Shock nearby enemies with a bio-electrical attack

feral diploid.d: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. It's acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.

feral diploid rex.d: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. It's acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.

frozen infested hive.d: Generates a coldness that reduces shields.

infested oni.d: An Infested beast of considerable strength long rumored to be lying dormant in the muck off the shores of Cetus.

mitosid.d: When pressured, this beast severs it's torso from its legs, yielding double trouble for its victims.

mitosid rex.d: Fiercely territorial, this beast lurks within the ruins of Deimos.

polyp-hog juggernaut.d: With the ability to track a scent from miles away, this Juggernaut is an invaluable ally when foraging rare Polyps from the ruins of Deimos

stabilization infested hive.d: Creates a field that lowers gravity.

tar mutalist moa.d: Discharges tar-like mucus slowing its prey

toxic ancient.d: Heavy melee unit that lashes out with a toxic flail.

toxic crawler.d: Releases a poison cloud on death

undying flyer.d: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.

volatile runner.d: Fast and explodes when near enemies

zealoid bastion.d: A subordinate loyal to the Zealoid Prelate, the Bastion renders regular Infested invulnerable.

zealoid prelate.d: Wreathed in an obfuscating black cloud the Zealoid Prelate brings Arlo's word with fire, blood and loyal Bastions who spring to his aid.

zealot baptizer.d: From Arlo the promise of a new life, a new form and a new word: death.

zealot herald.d: This Zealot targets petential converts with a spray of toxic sludge.

zealot proselytizer.d: Attacking with blade and gun, this Zealot spreads the 'message' with a hive of toxic, explosive pustules that grow on his back when he is attacked.

corrupted ancient.d: Heavy melee that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno.

corrupted drahk master.d: He came in search of Void treasure, the Orokin Neural Sentry had other plans.

corrupted nullifier.d: Energy shield blocks projectiles and nullifies powers

aerolyst.d: A support unit that can heal fellow Sentients. Canisters located near this units center of mass appear weaker than the surrounding carapace.

brachiolyst.d: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.

choralyst.d: These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.

condrix.d: This dropship ferries Sentient units from deep-space to battle zones around the Origin System.

dactolyst.d: Sentient Dactolyst, taken and twisted by the Anarch Galastra. Given the designation TQ-776VL by his captor, if the had taken an independent name before this, it has been lost.

decaying battalyst.d: Shielded by Hunhow using Suda's energy

eidolon gantulyst.d: A massive, lumbering, brute of an Eidolon.

eidolon hydrolyst.d: The energy contained within this Eidolon is powerful enough to alter the local weather system.

eidolon teralyst.d: An ancient Eidolon, searching for its lost brethren. Trying to make itself whole.

eidolon vomvalyst.d: A lost soul. Part energy, part physical shell, these Sentient remnants seem to have a symbiotic relationship with the much larger Eidolons.

gyrix.d: This unorthodox Sentient Fighter tumbles and twists through space, attack with its dual missile launchers and a barrage of swarming micro missiles.

ionyx.d: A heavy Sentient fighter that weakens targets with a slicing plasma wave and finishes them off with a massive energy orb.

orphix.d: These massive Sentients emit pulses that disable machinery, and deploy lesser Sentients that help to boost the pulse field. They have recently learned to disable Warframes.

ortholyst.d: This lightweight Sentient mounts itself to solid ground in order to deploy massive long range cannons.

ropalolyst.d: "Known and unknowable. This thing has haunted my life, waking and asleep, ever since I made that accursed bargain. A parasite at the core of my city. It drains my wealth, my power, my reactors... and my dignity. This will not stand. I will see that horrendous thing destroyed. I will be free." Alad V

summulyst.d: A high-order Sentient that bifurcates its body, creating a portal it uses to summon reinforcements and projectiles. Armed with twin cannons.

symbilyst.d: Frontline shock trooper that uses its large shield arm to block incoming damage.

typholyst.d: These rare, hulking Sentients pound adversaries to a pulp. Nearly immortal, they can only be killed by having their beating core torn from them.

tyro battalyst.d: A fledgling Battalyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.

tyro conculyst.d: A fledgling Conculyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.

narmer trooper.d: The Narmer Veil is in full control.

death scuttler.d: These aggressive and explosive Scuttlers have one purpose to fulfil in their short lives; protect their mother.

gruzzling.d: These greedy little Murmur tricksters love to steal Conduit Dockets and other coveted items from Albrecht's labs.

hurling fragment.d: Clings to the cliffs and walls, hurling masonry on anything unfortunate enough to be traveling below.

mocking whisper.d: This mocking phantom emerges to persecute the one who unwisely looked into its book, cutting deeply with hatred and blows alike. The book it arose from is its one vulnerability.

scathing whisper.d: Looking too deeply into Albrecht's lost grimoires may cause a void-born duplicate to appear, seething with contempt for the one who let it loose and hurling its wrath from afar. It cannot be banished until the book that gave rise to it is destroyed.

scuttler.d: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.

shuffling fragment.d: In its calcified chaos, the Indifference is disjointed even from itself.

the fragmented.d: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest into three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra which their bizarre master must travel.

the fragmented one.d: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest into three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra which their bizarre master must travel.

the unseeing herald.d: The Unseeing Herald proclaims the will of the Indifference, uttering its twisted desires in Voidtongue. Who among us have heard its whispers?

legacyte.d: With each generation, this Techrot predator becomes stronger, evolving new powers and attacks. Evolving these powerful creatures is metabolically costly for the Techrot, could this be exploited to weaken the Infestation?

techrot babau.d: The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.

techrot babau (temporal archimedea survi.d: The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.

techrot galliflex.d: This aggressive melee unit dashes at enemies, lashing out with frenzied strikes.

techrot matmas.d: This tottering, bulbous Techrot creation can inflate bladders to become airborne, raining down destruction on those below.

techrot miasmite.d: These tiny nodules of Techrot are the diabolic union of an arc welder and a gas can. Usually attacking in groups, they explode as soon as they near their target.

techrot obsolyte.d: Even redundant technology is given new life through the Technocyte Virus.

techrot skuzzi.d: Once a simple workstation, the servant has turned against its former masters.

techrot volatile galliflex.d: This self-sacrificing unit ignites its subsumed propane tank and then charges its prey, for the survival of the Hive.

scaldra jaeger.d: This rifle unit has been trained to suppress the enemy with volley after volley of machine gun fire.

scaldra flayer.d: Quick and lethal. This Scaldra unit has been trained to rush the target and inflict maximum damage with their curved blades.

scaldra barbican.d: Sporting a ballistic shield, this heavy unit closes the distance while laying down pistol fire. Carries an Efervon gel cannon.

scaldra harbinger.d: This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.

scaldra dedicant.d: This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.

scaldra eradicator.d: This support unit smokes out its target with gas grenades and finishes the job with blows from his massive club.

scaldra screamer.d: Specialized Scaldra demoltions unit, with an impressive vocal range.

scaldra ti-92.d: This armored personnel carrier is designed to move Scaldra forces quickly and easily around Höllvania. Its roof mounted turret provides lethal defense.

anarch arcus.d: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. It was not uncommon to witness Dax rangers supporting Tenno as they first leanrt to control their Warframes, filling in offensive gaps with precise aim.

anarch capsarii.d: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch dfaction. With shield above and staff in hand, Dax medics are as adept at healing as their brethren are at cutting down the opposition.

anarch gladius.d: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch dfaction. Within the minds of those dedicated to the blade lies a singular focus; to annihilate their enemy in the most effective manner possible.

anarch grineer lancer.d: A cloned soldier in top fighting form. Lancers formed the front line of the Orokin legions, advancing relentlessly to carry the full might of the army deep into enemy territory. Lancers were chosen for sheer-minded determination, the ones who found it hard to let go of an idea.

anarch grineer trapper.d: Only the most cunning of clone stock are chosen to become trappers. These are given training in the operation of Trapper Drones by Archimedea; many do not make it through the training. Trappers are frequently ostracized from their squads due to mishaps while they are learning to aim.

anarch libritor.d: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Across many operations, the thunderous salvo of a Libritor Archgun served as a signal for hidden Dax forced to emerge from the shadows and fall upon their enemies like a guillotine's blade.

anarch tenebra.d: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. While their ability and disappearing techniques allowed these Dax to quell revolts before they had formed in earnest, their experiences allowed for their own rebellion to to flourish where all others have failed.

alpine monitor sawgaw.d: 'Soar Gore' as the Solaris call it, this crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.

amethyst nexifera.d: A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks it opponents from above.

arbitration shield drone.d: The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.

ashen kuaka.d: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.

bau vasca kavat.d: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.

black-banded bolarola.d: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.

brindle kubrodon.d: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.

burrowing cryptilex.d: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.

caustic cryptilex.d: The most dangerous Cryptilex. They have glands in their abdomens that can emit an acidic spray.

coastal mergoo.d: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their lives to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.

common avichaea.d: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.

common condroc.d: A carrion-eater and opportunistic bird-of-prey. Condrocs gather, feed upon carrion, and occasionally, hunt in groups known as 'committees'. Several committees will be led by an Emperor.

crescent vulpaphyla.d: The Crescent is the most pugnacious subspecies of Vulpaphyla, they will rush anything they perceive as a threat. Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.

dappled horrasque.d: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.

delicate pobber.d: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source of Virmink and Sawgaw.

devotee.d: Touched by the hand of Arlo they come to spread his healing word. Rejoice.

dusky-headed virmink.d: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.

emperor condroc.d: A carrion-eater and opportunistic bird-of-prey. Condrocs gather, feed upon carrion, and occasionally, hunt in groups known as 'committees'. Several committees will be led by an Emperor.

fire-veined stover.d: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.

flossy sawgaw.d: 'Soar Gore' as the Solaris call it, this crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.

frogmouthed sawgaw.d: 'Soar Gore' as the Solaris call it, this crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.

follie.d: The Shadowgrapher hunts down any who dare enter her domain.

fuming dax stover.d: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.

ghost kuaka.d: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.

green velocipod.d: This large arthropod is generally found flying around Deimos' several grottos.

horrasque stormer.d: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.

howler undazoa.d: The Howler is easily startled. Its penetrating scream will cause other, more dangerous animals to investigate. Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.

kubrodon incarnadine.d: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.

medjay predasite.d: Not quite as flighty as its subspecies cousins, it will charge if it feels threatened. Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.

nephil vasca kavat.d: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.

oraxia.d: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar’s Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.

panzer vulpaphyla.d: This hardy creature has a collagenous dermis that acts as a thick, protective armor. Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.

pharaoh predasite.d: Easily frightened, this Predasite flees in the sight of danger, but not before hissing a geyser of parasitic sputum. Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.

plains kuaka.d: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.

purple velocipod.d: A sluggish highlands insect that's capable of bursts of speed when threatened.

saturn six fugitive.d: Broken out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen by the Wolf, this fugitive is a loyal member of his pack.

scarlet nexifera.d: Due to its remarkable strength, this Nexifera can cause seismic shocks when hitting the ground.

scuttlers.d: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.

sentinel stover.d: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.

septic cryptilex.d: This infectious insect is capable of hazardous viral attacks when alerted.

sly vulpaphyla.d: The most common Vulpaphyla, they travel in packs and are generally non-aggressive.

splendid mergoo.d: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their lives to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.

sporule avichaea.d: This capricious avian unleashes swarms of infested spores as its primary defense mechanism. Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.

spotted bolarola.d: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.

subterranean pobber.d: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source of Virmink and Sawgaw.

sunny pobber.d: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source of Virmink and Sawgaw.

swimmer horrasque.d: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.

syzygy attack drone.d: An attack drone that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys a heat-based aerosol befor pummeling targets from range with energy shells.

syzygy denial bursa.d: A Bursa unit that has been exposed to the power of the Syzygy. Corrals it's prey for rapid destruction.

syzygy light trencher.d: A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy, wields dual ice-picks and possess a flying charge attack. Explodes upon death.

syzygy mite raknoid.d: A diminutive Raknoid that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Occasionally lays explosive mushrooms.

syzygy prod crewman.d: A seasoned combatant that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Engages targets with quick strikes from it's shock baton.

syzygy shockwave moa.d: A Moa unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.

syzygy sniper ranger.d: A unit that has been exposed to the energy of Syzygy. Deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.

thrax centurion.d: The origin of these interlopers aboard the Zariman is a mystery to its crew members. Curiously, they are only visible to those who have been touched by the Void.

thrax legatus.d: The origin of these interlopers aboard the Zariman is a mystery to its crew members. Curiously, they are only visible to those who have been touched by the Void.

tomb protector.d: Watches over the Tomb of Inaros.

tomb protector effigy.d: Awoken by the Protector to help defend the Tomb of Inaros.

umber undazoa.d: A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.

vallis kubrodon.d: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.

vaporous undazoa.d: The Vaporous Undazoa gets its name from the noxious gas it belches out when alerted.

viridian nexifera.d: The Viridian Nexifera can produce a cloud of poisonous gas that's always best avoided.

viscid avichaea.d: The rarest of Avichaeas, the Viscid produces a thick, tar-like mucus that it discharges when imperiled. Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.

vitriol necramite.d: An Entrat maintenance drone carring a phial of corrosive solution, to top up laboratory devices

vizier predasite.d: A skittish creature, the Vizier Predasite will unleash a spume of acid before scurrying away.

void angel.d: Often found cocooned on the walls of the Zariman, the Void Angels were once human-like manifestations of people who died in the aftermath of the Zariman disaster. Over time they succumbed to the Void's song, and transformed into these angel-like creatures. They do not like to be disturbed.

white velocipod.d: The fastest variety of Velocipod, it tends to favor the swamplands.

white-breasted virmink.d: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.

wolf of saturn six.d: The only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.

woodland mergoo.d: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their lives to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
